experiences.name: Northern Lights Hunting Tour
experiences.description: Join a guided evening tour away from Reykjavik's light pollution to witness the Aurora Borealis dancing across the Arctic sky. Expert guides use real-time forecasts to find the best viewing spots, and you'll learn about the science behind this natural phenomenon while photographing the lights.

experiences.name: Blue Lagoon Geothermal Spa
experiences.description: Soak in the world-famous milky-blue geothermal waters rich in silica and minerals. Enjoy in-water massages, silica mud masks, and steam caves while surrounded by dramatic lava fields. Book the Comfort package for access to the lagoon, silica mud mask, and algae mask.

experiences.name: Snæfellsjökull Glacier Hike
experiences.description: Hike across the mystical Snæfellsjökull glacier atop an active volcano immortalized by Jules Verne. A certified glacier guide leads you through ice formations, crevasses, and volcanic craters while offering panoramic views of the Snæfellsnes Peninsula and the Atlantic Ocean on clear days.

experiences.name: Secret Lagoon Natural Hot Spring
experiences.description: Relax in Iceland's oldest swimming pool, a natural hot spring dating back to 1891 surrounded by geothermal activity including small geysers and bubbling pools. Far less crowded than the Blue Lagoon, this authentic experience offers warm 38–40°C waters in a stunning rural landscape.

experiences.name: Landmannalaugar Highland Trek & Hot Spring
experiences.description: Trek through Iceland's surreal rainbow-colored rhyolite mountains in the Highlands, passing obsidian lava fields, steaming fumaroles, and vivid mineral deposits. End the hike with a natural geothermal hot spring soak in the wild, one of Iceland's most rewarding backcountry experiences.
